He is the creator of Srevox, a self-hosted Kubernetes observability and incident intelligence platform. Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA). ## Featured project: Srevox
- Website: https://srevox.in — Docs: https://docs.srevox.in
- Self-hosted Kubernetes observability & incident intelligence platform ("100% Self-Hosted • Zero Data Leaks")
- Real-time CrashLoopBackOff, OOMKilled and LivenessProbe detection
- Live pod log streaming in the browser
- AI root-cause analysis using OpenAI, Anthropic or Ollama
- Alerts via Slack, Teams and Email; service-owner routing and audit logging
- Stack: Next.js, Go, Kubernetes, Helm, PostgreSQL, Redis
- 3,454+ Docker image pulls; one-command install via setup script
